title: Two engine starts at once break the engine packages: the first picture after an update is refused
description: Found at the 2.1.1 update test (install d, 2026-10-19): after the app moved its own engine 0.34.0 -> 0.42.1 at launch, /comfy/start ran twice 1.2 s apart. The route marks the engine running only after its multi-minute curated pip pass, so both passed the already-running check and ran pip on one site-packages; one died on WinError 32, wrote .cubric_python_deps_failed, and the one that succeeded never cleared it. The engine came up reading 'degraded' and the first generation was refused (python_deps_broken) until a restart. Fix: /comfy/start runs one start at a time; a second caller waits and then finds the engine running.
